summary: An attacker can fill all signed phase solution slots with invalid submissions at low cost, which prevents honest miners from participating.
details: For Polkadot, if there is a base deposit of 40 DOT, with the `SignedMaxSubmissions` parameter set to 16, an attacker could fill up all slots with invalid solutions, to DoS the signed phase. This will cost 16 * 40 = 640 DOT. While an exponential deposit increment was introduced as a mitigation, it remains insufficient: with only 16 solution slots and a 10% increment factor, the total cost to fill all slots is still only around 1400 DOT,  which is not unrealistic for an attacker to try a DoS attack. This allows an attacker to block all honest solution miners from participating, potentially forcing the election into emergency mode.

database_specific.mitigation: The affected pallet has become obsolete and been superseded by a new implementation.

database_specific.title: Exponential deposit increment factor severely capped by `SignedMaxSubmissions`, effectively still allowing attackers to cause DoS by filling up all solution slots.
